model_identity_note: The user supplied the artifact name. Exact provider model/revision telemetry is not exposed and is not inferred from that name.

authoring.method: Mathematical reasoning; tools for specification reading and writing source bytes.
authoring.post_freeze_checks: Independent compilation and contract fixtures only; no performance-based source revisions.

session_estimates.start_proxy: Attachment first available in scratch; includes the initial clarification interval, not solely active implementation time.

estimated_total_tokens_through_source_fr.definition: Rough unique-context plus generated-token estimate for the session through source freeze, including the supplied specification, instructions/history, source, and other authoring output. Not an API billing total or a sum of repeated cached prompt processing.
estimated_total_tokens_through_source_fr.basis: Approximately 17k specification tokens, 7-9k source tokens, and broad allowance for supplied context and authoring generation. No provider tokenizer or exact reasoning-token counter is available.

session_estimates.integration_and_verification: Excluded from the authoring time/token estimates; recorded separately in Git and the handoff.

estimated_total_tokens_through_first_com.definition: Same rough unique-context plus generation basis as the source-freeze estimate, adding post-freeze repository inspection through first compilation confirmation. Not provider billing telemetry.
